description: This file defines the React component 'CompanyCard' along with a helper component 'AvatarGroupIterator'. 'CompanyCard' displays information about a company, including its name, sector, contacts, and deals, using Material UI components and react-admin hooks. It references external components like 'CompanyAvatar' and 'Avatar', and interacts with data from react-admin's context.

methods.name: CompanyCard
methods.description: React functional component that renders a card with company details, including name, sector, contacts, and deals.

methods.name: AvatarGroupIterator
methods.description: Sub-component that displays a group of contact avatars based on list context data.
